name: Blink
description:
Concentration, up to 1 minute.

Roll a feat die at the end of each of your turns:

  • On a 1-5, nothing happens.

  • On a 6-10, you phase out for 1 round.

  • On 🌞, you no longer need to roll each turn and may phase in or out once each turn as a free action.

  • On 💀, you phase out for the next minute, regardless of concentration. Check a Condition.

Describe how you disappear and reappear.
